Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
mer...@pips01.informatik.uni-mannheim.de (Martin Engelhardt) writes:

>Hello Rulesgurus & enthralled readers,

>two questions came to mind late last night:

>regarding the fortune teller and Darius Styx special ability; if I
>draw a card and it is equipment, may I steal this exact card? In other
>words, is my opponent allowed to shuffle his hand anytime she wants?

Shuffle - schmuffle. A random draw is a random draw. If the only way
to get a random draw is to shuffle between draws, than you shuffle between
draws. You may not 'mark' his cars in any way - not by noting the
position any more than bending a corner down. Both of these methods are
cheating because the produce a non-random draw (opposing card text, which
is cheating).

>regarding Archon Investigation: Harrod has secured himself the
>services of Tasha Morgan. He is bleeding his Masters prey, who has 3
>pool left. The Meth. beeing bled then plays Archon Investigation (for
>thos who don't know: Master OOT, 3 Pool, play when beeing bled for
>more than 3 pool, burn the bleeding vampire, don't take pool loss from
>bleed). What does happen:
>a) Harrod is burned, prey is ousted

This is correct. Master cards, actions, etc. all are paid for simultaneously
as they resolve.

Messages.Author: Martin Engelhardt
Messages.Body:
Hello Rulesgurus & enthralled readers,

two questions came to mind late last night:

regarding the fortune teller and Darius Styx special ability; if I
draw a card and it is equipment, may I steal this exact card? In other
words, is my opponent allowed to shuffle his hand anytime she wants?

regarding Archon Investigation: Harrod has secured himself the

services of Tasha Morgan. He is bleeding his Masters prey, who has 3
pool left. The Meth. beeing bled then plays Archon Investigation (for
thos who don't know: Master OOT, 3 Pool, play when beeing bled for
more than 3 pool, burn the bleeding vampire, don't take pool loss from
bleed). What does happen:
a) Harrod is burned, prey is ousted

b) prey is ousted, Harrod is not burned because the prey killed
himself with the attempted AI (which does not resolve anymore because
by paying the 3 pool the Meth ousted himself)

I'll let you know when we come up with yet more questions :-)

Martin
